items.title: Avenda Health expands Unfold AI platform to support intraoperative prostate cancer care
items.summary: Surgery Mode in Unfold AI brings patient-specific 3D maps to give an enhanced view of cancer anatomy during robotic prostate procedures.The post Avenda Health expands Unfold AI platform to support intraoperative prostate cancer care appeared first on The Robot Report.
